                    )
                ) * 'SGA Cost-Budget Forecast'[SGA Plan Check],

                        'SGA Cost Actuals'[SGA Hours],
                        CROSSFILTER ( 'Version'[Version Key], 'SGA Cost Actuals'[Version Key], NONE )
                    ),
                    FILTER ( 'Time', RIGHT ( 'Time'[Year Month Code], 2 ) <= "09" )
                )
                    + (
                        CALCULATE (
                            'SGA Cost-Budget Forecast'[SGA Hours (Bud/Fcst)],
                            FILTER ( 'Time', RIGHT ( 'Time'[Year Month Code], 2 ) > "09" )
                        )
                    ) * 'SGA Cost-Budget Forecast'[SGA Plan Check],
                IF (
                    SelectedPlanningVersion = "Actuals",
                    'SGA Cost Actuals'[SGA Hours],
                    IF (
                        SelectedPlanningVersion = "Actuals PY",
                        CALCULATE (
                            'SGA Cost Actuals'[SGA Hours PY],
                            CROSSFILTER ( 'Version'[Version Key], 'SGA Cost Actuals'[Version Key], NONE )
                        ),
